verdicts.reason: A reads left to right with a clear headline, a stacked badge column and a prominent CTA. However, the SUNSET SALE ribbon collides with the logo and the can, the can is tiny, the legal copy is cramped and illegible in the top-right corner, and a stray grey placeholder chip sits under the CTA. B has the wrong hierarchy: the legal copy is blown up into a large block under the logo and competes with the headline, while the SUNSET SALE badge shrinks to an unreadable chip. The three badges are scattered as tiny fragments (one above the CTA, two below it), and a stray red mark floats beside the headline.
